检索记录(避免重复立卡):按关键词与文件路径各查了一轮 open issues(`EmbeddableForm` / `EmbeddableForm.tsx` / 倒计时不递减 / frozen countdown / `redirecting` 文案),命中只有 #5073 本身,无同题卡片,故新立。未指派 —— 仅记录,不占坑。

补一句正文被 issues 端点截掉的收尾。

Triage (first-touch, triage seat, session `session_01HXzdkKx5WjwwCTT3c7U5kB`): promoted `finding` → `pm:queue`, type Task — the public-form thank-you panel claims "remaining seconds" in 10 locales and never decrements; small, concrete, user-visible on a published surface.

Scope: either implement the countdown per the card's shape (interval keyed on the accepted destination, owned by the effect per PR #5070's ownership model — cancel on unmount and `handleReset`; do not recreate the unowned-timer defect #5049 removed), or change the template family to wording that doesn't promise a remaining count (that route touches all 10 locale packs). Dev's choice; the first is preferred since the locale strings already promise decrementing semantics.

Size/model suggestion: S, `mode:subagent`.

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Claim: PM loop round 14

Session: `session_01RV6yuVCxymHYE16PL9vQkE`
Branch: `claude/issue-5083-embeddable-form-countdown`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-5083`
Domain: `repo:objectui`
File surface: `packages/plugin-form/src/**` (EmbeddableForm and its tests); the 10 locale packs only if you take the wording route (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: S, `mode:subagent`, `model: sonnet` (taking the triage seat's suggestion)
Clause-②: **no** — no contract surface changes; this makes a rendered string tell the truth.
Serial constraints cleared: **`packages/plugin-form` is free.** In-flight PRs at claim time hold disjoint surfaces: PR #5290 `apps/console`, PR #5294 `packages/plugin-view`, PR #5295 `.github/workflows` + `scripts/` + root manifests, PR #5297 `packages/plugin-map`, PR #5298 `packages/components` + `packages/types`, PR #5300 / #5303 `packages/plugin-dashboard`, PR #5302 `packages/cli`. Sibling dispatch this round is #4906 (`packages/plugin-report`) — disjoint.

## Scope, per the triage ruling

The public-form thank-you panel promises "remaining seconds" in **10 locales** and never decrements — a static number rendered once and left there for the whole wait.

Two routes; **the first is preferred and the triage seat said why**: the locale strings already promise decrementing semantics, so changing the copy would be retreating from a promise the product already makes.

1. **Implement the countdown** — interval keyed on the accepted destination, owned by the effect per **PR #5070's ownership model**: cancel on unmount **and** on `handleReset`.
   ⛔ **Do not recreate the unowned-timer defect that #5049 removed.** Read both before writing — this is a repo that has already paid for getting timer ownership wrong here.
2. Change the template family to wording that makes no numeric promise — touches all 10 locale packs.

Your choice, but justify it if you pick 2.

## Verification

Re-derive on current `origin/main` first (the card is ~2 days old; note `main` just took the CI fix from #5304). Test that the number **actually decreases over time** — a test asserting only the initial render would pass against the current broken behaviour. Use fake timers; assert the interval is cleared on unmount and on `handleReset` (that's the #5049 regression surface).

**Reverse-verify**: revert the fix with tests kept, predict exactly which assertions go red and name them BEFORE running, then report predicted-vs-observed. Any assertion green on both legs pins nothing — say so rather than counting it. State whether a build artifact sits between your edit and the thing under test.

Changeset: `patch` on `@object-ui/plugin-form`. ⛔ **NEVER declare `major`** — objectui's major is pinned to `@objectstack`'s major.
⛔ Do not edit `content/docs/releases/`, `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`.

Added packages/plugin-form/src/thankYouRedirectCountdown.ts (useRedirectCountdownSeconds), a per-second setInterval owned by an effect keyed on the accepted pendingRedirect destination, on the same ownership model PR #5070 established -- cancelled on unmount and on handleReset, the exact regression surface #5049 fixed; self-clears on reaching 0.   "tests": "No build artifact sits between the edit and the thing under test -- vitest transforms the .ts/.tsx source directly via Vite on every run; the separate `pnpm --filter build` runs below are correctness checks (bundling/dts), not a dependency of the test run. Commands (final HEAD 6029bdfa8, plugin-form worktree): `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-form^...' build` clean; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form build` clean, no TS errors; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check` clean; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form test` -> 574/574 passed (56 files), including 3 new cases in EmbeddableForm.redirectCountdownTick.test.tsx (fake timers, 4s delay, asserts 4->3->2->1->0 decrementing text, interval-armed spy, self-clear at 0, clearInterval on unmount, clearInterval on handleReset with a getByLabelText(/email/i) counter-probe pairing the 'no countdown' zero-assertion). eslint on the 3 changed/new files: 0 errors. node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs / check-changeset-no-major.mjs / check-changeset-fixed.mjs / check-control-bytes.mjs / check-lint-coverage.mjs / check-type-check-coverage.mjs: all green, plus a manual grep -naP control-byte self-scan (clean). Reverse-verification, predicted BEFORE running (recorded in the test file's own docblock): reverting EmbeddableForm.tsx only (to de4e29a81, one commit pre-fix) with tests kept would fail all 3 tests at `expect(armed.length).toBe(1)` (reverted code never calls setInterval), while the preceding 'Redirecting in 4 seconds' initial-render assertion would stay green (already correct pre-fix, demonstrating it alone pins nothing). Measured: exactly that -- all 3 tests failed with identical `AssertionError: expected +0 to be 1` at that line, nothing failed on the initial-render text. Restored the committed EmbeddableForm.tsx; all 3 return to green with no other change. Every zero-assertion in the new tests is paired with a known-present neighbouring term (stale-seconds-text absence paired with fresh-seconds-text presence; post-reset countdown absence paired with the fresh form's email label being present).",
  "open_questions": [],
  "out_of_scope_findings": []
}
